_doc: Steering A/B on ee->WW, MSE of log|M|^2 on the mixture test split (10k). baseline: each cell's tp_scr search best on its own test (scripts/job_cross_eval.sh, run FA-ccin2p3-daaf576d); steered: tps_calib, one run per cell at the baseline best's HPs on the sigma-steered pool, scored with the off-shellness stats pinned (FA-lxplus-140b066a). Keys: k of D = 10^(k/2). steered_search: the best of each steered cell's own 8-trial search (tps_scr, D <= 10^3), scored the same way (FA-lxplus-d05e6162).
